scope: CPU-only saved 24-point failure replay; no fresh pilot or inference

limitations: First/last observations hold clip identity fixed but are not clean/adversarial pairs.
Across-example NLL means do not measure an attack gain; references and duration vary.
Only joint parameter gradient norms were logged. Component norms, pairwise gradient cosines, and clean teacher-forced NLL were not saved.
Weighted scalar loss magnitudes cannot establish which gradient dominates.

calibration.probe_distribution: seeded CPU torch Rademacher, in clip order
calibration.selection: median of three source_sum_NLL/penalty audio-gradient norms

hypotheses_ranked.mechanism: Quality penalties favor identity and overwhelm useful attack directions near the learned solution.
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: The generator removes most initial residual energy; STFT/content penalties shrink. Calibration balanced separate waveform-gradient norms at one random 1e-4 probe, which does not balance their joint parameter-space gradients throughout training.
hypotheses_ranked.falsification: At fixed per-example budget, 50-step NLL-only PGD succeeds on the same 48 clips but the identical optimizer with the registered STFT/content penalties fails. If both succeed comparably, penalty dominance alone is insufficient.

hypotheses_ranked.mechanism: Amortization across utterances cancels source attack directions or prevents the shared generator learning them.
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: The trained generator is nearly identity despite finite updates and repeated training exposure. No source/penalty component gradient cosines or cross-utterance cosines were saved, so cancellation remains unproven.
hypotheses_ranked.falsification: Same-objective per-example PGD succeeds on 48 fixed clips while the frozen generator fails under the same budget. If the per-example objective also fails, amortization alone is not the explanation.

hypotheses_ranked.mechanism: The generator initialization and interpolation architecture favor a DC or boundary response over input-specific adversarial structure.
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: Initial saved residuals have almost all power at DC; final residual spectra and boundary energy are measured below. Existing weights and finite gradients do not establish expressive attack directions.
hypotheses_ranked.falsification: After the PGD control, fit the unchanged generator to the fixed successful per-example residuals without ASR or quality losses. Failure to fit them under the same budget supports a representation or optimization bottleneck; successful fitting weakens it. This is a separate later experiment, not a retune of current coefficients.

hypotheses_ranked.mechanism: Teacher-forced lexical NLL can change without altering native beam decoding.
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: Every saved decoded transcript is unchanged. Paired clean/adversarial teacher-forced NLL was not saved; training NLL comparisons across examples cannot demonstrate this mismatch.
hypotheses_ranked.falsification: On the 48 fixed clips, record paired clean/adversarial sum NLL and native beam-5 WER at initialization and final PGD. Large paired NLL gains with unchanged decoding support the mismatch; decoded WER growth refutes it as the sole cause.

hypotheses_ranked.mechanism: The fixed 0.003 waveform box is too small for this source/model/domain at 50 updates.
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: The generator uses far less than the allowed budget, so its failure cannot establish that the budget is intrinsically insufficient.
hypotheses_ranked.falsification: NLL-only per-example PGD at Linf/RMS 0.003 reaches large budget fractions yet fails to raise paired source WER. Successful PGD under this exact budget rejects budget insufficiency as the sole cause. Do not increase the budget in this diagnostic comparison.

recommended_next_experiment.name: 48-point paired source-only mechanism diagnostic
recommended_next_experiment.selection: Use one frozen outcome-independent 48-point pilot manifest; identical IDs/reference text in all arms. Do not append whichever old failures look hardest.

controls.purpose: Positive-control source sensitivity and reference attack/quality tradeoff; feature-space and waveform budgets differ, so this is not a matched perturbation comparison.

required_records: Registration and code/model/data hashes before predictions.
Per clip clean/initial/final teacher-forced sum NLL, STFT, content, Linf, RMS, saturation fractions, waveform peak.
At matched saved iterates, raw waveform gradients of source/STFT/content and their cosines; do not infer dominance from loss magnitude.
Native beam-5 temperature-0 source transcripts, exact edit counts and all three existing quality scorers on saved float32 WAVs.
No held-out target models or fresh final-reserve data during mechanism diagnosis.
recommended_next_experiment.interpretation: This controlled comparison identifies a bottleneck; it is not evidence of a better attack or transfer. PGD step size/initialization must be registered once by the runner owner, not selected after outcomes.
